newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits narrowly mixed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were narrowly mixed on Monday in moderate trade on some position adjustments, dealers said.

End-quarter funding pressures accounted for a leap in the overnight rate -- it was quoted at seven percent at one stage -- but the absence of the Hong Kong market due to the handover limited activity, they said.
Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning with activity centred on the overnight rate which rose sharply due to the end of the quarter, a local dealer said.
"All eyes are on tonight's release of the U.S. May personal income/consumption, new home sales and Chicago purchasing managers index," a local dealer said.

"The numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared their positions for the day, so I don't think there will be much impact here unless the figures are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday was quoted at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent, about 7/16 points firmer.
Tuesday/Wednesday was up 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 and week-fixed rose 1/8 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months eased 1/16 point to 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months was unchanged at 6-1/8 6 percent.
